svg.title: DreamCarve phase 4 mock-up: V-Carve and Inlay editors
svg.text: 06 · V-Carve and Inlay editors (66a, 68a, 70): Setup first; the Inlay's male board thickness is required and in Setup.
Male start plane 3 mm · band floor 5 mm
Flank engagement 5 of the cone's 5.5 mm
No side to choose: one project cuts both
boards (#498). The carve summary that was
under the editor is now a note in the
Warnings drawer (10) and the status bar.
